scenario.operatorMessage: Can we just put it on the passenger flight?

rule: CRITICAL · booked aircraft illegal for commodity

options.title: Move to freighter AYC 9006
options.constraint_check: Main-deck freighter accepts UN3480 PI965. Capacity confirmed. Passenger AYC 176 cannot carry it.
options.action: Offload AWB 172-44091832 from passenger AYC 176 and rebook AYC 9006.

options.title: Next freighter AYC 9012
options.constraint_check: Also legal for PI965. Use it only if AYC 9006 is full.
options.action: Book AYC 9012 and keep the freight in the DGR cage.

options.title: Ask for a pax variation
options.constraint_check: UN3480 packed alone (PI965) is forbidden on passenger aircraft. There is no station variation.

options.title: Return to shipper
options.constraint_check: Last resort. The customer has a legal freighter path tonight.
options.action: Hold in the DGR cage and call Helvetia Cell only if both freighters refuse.
